sn48.49:1.2: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme || || 2.
sn48.49:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā Piṇḍolabharadvājena aññā vyākatā hoti ||
sn48.49:1.4: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmī ti || || 3.
sn48.49:1.5: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupa. saṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn48.49:2.3: Kiṃ nu kho bhante atthavasaṃ sampassamānena āyasmatā Piṇḍolabhāradvājena aññā vyākatā
sn48.49:3.1: Tiṇṇannam kho pana bhikkhave indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā Piṇḍolabhāradvājena bhikkhunā aññā vyākatā
sn48.49:3.5: Imesaṃ kho bhante tiṇṇannam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā Piṇḍolabhāradvājena bhikkhunā aññā vyākatā ||
sn48.49:3.6: Khīnā jāti- -nāparam itthattāyā ti pajānāmī ti || || 7.
sn48.49:3.7: Imāni ca bhikkhave tīṇi indriyāni || || Kiṃnantāni ||
sn48.49:3.11: Jātijarāmaraṇaṃ khayan ti kho bhikkhave sampassamānena Piṇḍolabhāradvājena bhikkhunā aññā vyākatā ||
sn48.49:3.12: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karāṇīyaṃ || nāparam itthattāyā ti pajānāmī
